criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Personally inspect each exact final frame. Concept personally inspected; retain slim whole habit. Remove stacked bark-scale look and inconsistent twiglike tip counts. Explicit48 leaves with two successive forks and four tips each, subtler rhomboid cushions, more space between leaves.

Verify One gently curved slender unbranched axis, no massive tree trunk or branches; helically placed leaf cushions and narrow leaves along axis, closer toward apex. Forty-eight connected leaves, each first dividing into two and each arm dividing again into four narrow pointed terminal tips; wider second fork than first. Small attachment pouch/leaf-base curve starts near perpendicular then rises upward; axis remains visible through open foliage. Conservative living aboveground single-axis habit reconstruction informed by authorFig12. Original fragments and mechanical estimates do not prove whole height. Nominal1.6m axis is illustrative. Root system unknown and omitted; no flowers, cones or assumed family identity. Forty-eight helical leaves are an art count, each selected mature twice-forking form, not universal ontogeny.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.

scale.axes: Blender world XYZ; final transformed vertices, including caps, relief and grounding. GLB Y-up measured separately.
scale.hard_component_extent_policy: Every tagged solid component must have finite positive world extents, lie inside complete object hard bounds, and largest world extent <= complete object upper longest-axis bound. No scientific min thickness inferred. All actual transformed percomponent XYZ and PCA extents measured, with no hidden final scaling.
scale.hard_ranges_are: Broad authored display envelopes, not fossil measurements or scientific size limits. Nominal inputs are not separate equality requirements.
scale.accuracy: Interpretive educational art, not specimen cast.

origin: Grounded lowest vertexz0, X/Ycentered; translation only, no final normalizing scale.

intended_use.limits: No GPU, composed-scene or dynamics acceptance.

surface_profile: Opaque flat-faceted full-volume geometry; no alpha, textures, emission or double-sided defect concealment.

concept_inspection.decisions: Concept personally inspected; retain slim whole habit. Remove stacked bark-scale look and inconsistent twiglike tip counts. Explicit48 leaves with two successive forks and four tips each, subtler rhomboid cushions, more space between leaves.

numeric_semantics: Integer counts are explicit construction choices, not fossil universals. Lengths/radii/widths are nominal artistic inputs; only separately declared hard world envelopes and budget ceilings are pass constraints. Actual component sizes and contact samples must be measured after every transform.
contact_policy: Each named leaf base contacts its actual parent stem/rachis; each vein physically contacts its lamina; axis junctions and petiole blends have no exposed pedestal/collar or dangling sheets. Surface samples/ray parity and multidirectional pixels required, not centers alone.
